# 21st Memory

> A free companion archive of the Thalon Thor / Christian21 transmissions — the Great Remembering. Reports, infographics, slide decks, videos and quizzes across 860 topics. No religion, no finance, no gatekeeping. Everything is free to read at 21stmemory.com. The original transmission is the final word.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://21stmemory.com/): The Great Remembering Has Begun — start here.
- [Codex](https://21stmemory.com/codex.html): The full topic archive, all six series.
- [The Master Mind Map](https://21stmemory.com/series-mind-map.html): the whole record as one tree — eleven main limbs and hundreds of nodes, still growing; reports coming soon.
- [A Brief Synopsis of Revelations](https://21stmemory.com/series-revelations.html): 118 topics — soul architecture, the simulation field, the parasitic farm, resets.
- [Following Alice in the Rabbit Hole](https://21stmemory.com/series-alice.html): 113 topics — hidden history, resets, giants, the Amnesia Vortex, awakening.
- [Mega Breakdown Board Notes & Highlights](https://21stmemory.com/series-breakdown.html): 151 topics — board notes, grid systems, parasite mechanics, the homecoming.
- [The Long-Awaited Ascension Process](https://21stmemory.com/series-ascension.html): 39 topics — the crystal grid, the three flashes, the portal.
- [Special Requests](https://21stmemory.com/series-special-requests.html): 2 topics.
- [Books](https://21stmemory.com/books.html): Seven free Codex books (PDF and EPUB) and at-cost print editions.
- [Quizzes](https://21stmemory.com/quizzes.html): 25-question Living Truth quiz per topic.
- [Network](https://21stmemory.com/network.html): Where to find 21st Memory — video, podcast, social and archive channels.
- [Source](https://21stmemory.com/source.html): The original transmissions at christian21.com.
- [Support](https://21stmemory.com/support.html): How to support the work.
